OVERLAYS.text: What did your mother put on top of her rice?

OVERLAYS.name: Cold Rice Makes Fried Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Fried rice: one cup of cold rice, one egg, one tablespoon of oil, a quarter cup of peas and carrots, one green onion, two teaspoons of soy sauce,…

OVERLAYS.name: An Egg on Top
OVERLAYS.text: Fry the egg sunny side up in the same pan and set it on top.

OVERLAYS.name: Rinse It
OVERLAYS.text: Rinse half a cup of rice three times, until the water is almost clear.

OVERLAYS.name: Toast It First
OVERLAYS.text: Toast the rice in one teaspoon of butter, two or three minutes, until it smells like popcorn.

OVERLAYS.name: Oven Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Oven rice: half a cup of rice, one cup of boiling water, half a teaspoon of butter, a pinch of salt, foil tight, three hundred fifty degrees,…

OVERLAYS.name: The Knuckle
OVERLAYS.text: On the stove, water up to your first knuckle.

OVERLAYS.name: Don't Peek
OVERLAYS.text: Lowest heat, lid on, eighteen minutes, no peeking.

OVERLAYS.name: The Towel
OVERLAYS.text: Off the heat, a dish towel under the lid, ten minutes.

OVERLAYS.name: Fix Wet Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Wet rice goes on a sheet pan at three hundred degrees for five minutes.

OVERLAYS.name: Scorched Bottom
OVERLAYS.text: Burnt bottom, spoon off the top, soak the pan with baking soda.

OVERLAYS.name: Cook It in Broth
OVERLAYS.text: Cook it in one cup of broth with a bay leaf.

OVERLAYS.name: Microwave Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Microwave rice: half a cup of rice, one cup of water, a big bowl, five minutes high, ten minutes half power, five minutes under a plate.

OVERLAYS.name: Cook Once, Eat Five Times
OVERLAYS.text: Cook a whole cup once, with two cups of boiling water, thirty minutes in the oven.

OVERLAYS.name: Cool It Fast
OVERLAYS.text: Spread it thin to cool, into the icebox within the hour, never more than two hours out.

OVERLAYS.name: Freeze It Flat
OVERLAYS.text: One cup to a bag, pressed flat.

OVERLAYS.name: Write on Every Bag
OVERLAYS.text: Write rice and the date on every bag.

OVERLAYS.name: Warm Frozen Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Warm it with a tablespoon of water under a damp towel, two minutes, until it's steaming hot, only once.

OVERLAYS.name: Muffin Tin Pucks
OVERLAYS.text: Muffin tin pucks, half a cup each.

OVERLAYS.name: How Long It Keeps
OVERLAYS.text: Three or four days in the icebox, two months in the freezer, brown rice kept cold.

OVERLAYS.name: Glass Jar and a Bay Leaf
OVERLAYS.text: Dry rice in a glass jar with a tight lid and a bay leaf.

OVERLAYS.name: Rice Patties
OVERLAYS.text: Rice patties: one cup of rice, one egg, two tablespoons of flour, two tablespoons of cheddar, three minutes a side.

OVERLAYS.name: Cheesy Broccoli Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Cheesy broccoli rice: one cup of rice, half a cup of broccoli, a quarter cup of cheddar, two tablespoons of milk, three hundred fifty degrees,…

OVERLAYS.name: Stuffed Pepper Half
OVERLAYS.text: Stuffed pepper half: half a cup of rice, two ounces of beef, a quarter cup of tomato sauce, three hundred seventy-five degrees, twenty-five minutes.

OVERLAYS.name: Rice and Bean Bowl
OVERLAYS.text: Rice and bean bowl: half a cup of rice, half a cup of beans, two tablespoons of salsa, one minute.

OVERLAYS.name: Rice in Soup, the Right Way
OVERLAYS.text: Keep the rice out of the soup pot and add a puck to the bowl.

OVERLAYS.name: Thicken Soup with Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Mash a quarter cup of rice into thin soup to thicken it. And the chicken and rice soup: one cup of broth, half a cup of water, carrot, celery,…

OVERLAYS.name: Rice Pudding in a Mug
OVERLAYS.text: Rice pudding in a mug: half a cup of rice, half a cup of milk, one tablespoon of sugar, cinnamon and raisins, about two and a half minutes. At…

OVERLAYS.name: Glorified Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Glorified rice: half a cup of rice, a quarter cup of pineapple, a quarter cup of whipped topping, marshmallows and a cherry.

OVERLAYS.name: Breakfast Rice
OVERLAYS.text: Breakfast rice with warm milk, brown sugar and cinnamon. Half a cup of each, one minute.

OVERLAYS.name: The Sunday Rice Plan
OVERLAYS.text: One cup of dry rice on Sunday makes five meals.
